_note: Channel-wide settings the episode pipeline reads (tools/episode/plan_next.py, the linters and the gates). Change them here, not in the code.

length._note: Every new episode lasts min_seconds to cap_seconds, end hold included: just over 1 minute, so it counts as 'over 1 minute' on TikTok (owner's decision, 2026-11-06). The end hold after the last line stretches from 0.9 s up to the end_hold maximum to reach min_seconds (tools/episode/build.py); a voice track too short or too long for that is fixed with the gaps between lines. Legacy episodes keep their 0.9 s hold.

hook_test._note: A/B test of the opening line (docs/HOOK_TEST.md). Inside the test, even episodes use 'bold' and odd ones 'question'. Set 'winner' to stop alternating.

topics._note: Share of episodes built on something trending (the rest are random everyday objects). Episodes go in pairs so trend and random days split evenly across both hook styles.

variety._note: How different each episode's shape must be from recent ones (docs/SCRIPTING.md, Variety).
